Add motion only when it communicates state or improves usability.

- Create docs/design/MOTION_GUIDELINES.md, INTERACTION_SPECIFICATIONS.md, and ANIMATION_AUDIT.md.
- Use Emil animation skills and accessibility-safe timing.
- Audit existing motion and remove unnecessary movement.
